items.title: The 'hunting season' came for Iranians, then the US struck
items.description: As we journey into the heart of Iran, we meet the women who support the clerics and want revenge on the man who killed Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

items.title: Time for Russia to make a deal to end Ukraine war, Trump says
items.description: Donald Trump says Moscow should "make a deal" to end the war with Ukraine as G7 leaders have agreed to intensify pressure on Russia.

items.title: Jacinta Allan refuses to admit cost of CFMEU corruption to taxpayers
items.description: Embattled Victorian Premier Jacinta Allan has refused to answer repeated questions over how much CFMEU corruption has cost taxpayers in the state, a scandal that has put the government and her leadership under threat.

items.title: El Niño declared by BOM and it could become the strongest on record
items.description: El Niño is a state which can linger for up to 12 months and disrupt weather patterns across the globe, with Australia especially prone.

items.title: Deal says 'loud and clear' that Iran won't have a nuclear weapon: Trump
items.description: Speaking on the sidelines of the G7 in France, Donald Trump says Iran will never have nuclear weapons.

items.title: Russian artist who satirised Putin shot dead in Poland
items.description: Two Belarusian nationals are arrested in connection with the killing, authorities say.

items.title: Reserve Bank keeps interest rate at 4.35pc as economy slows
items.description: The Reserve Bank keeps the interest rate at 4.35pc as Australia's economy slows down.

items.title: Two men arrested by Dezi Freeman investigators
items.description: Police executed seven warrants at properties across Victoria and New South Wales this morning.

items.title: FBI says plot to attack White House UFC event with drones thwarted
items.description: US media says five people are in custody in connection with the plot, that involved flying explosive-laden drones towards buildings near last weekend's White House UFC match.

items.title: The war has been a disaster for Trump and his aims in Iran are unmet
items.description: The ceasefire agreement fits a pattern from Donald Trump where the signing of a deal appears to be the major goal and the details often seem a distant secondary consideration.

items.title: Birth doula says lack of consent delayed Triple Zero call for dying mother
items.description: A court probing the death of Stacey Warnecke after a freebirth has heard that emergency care was delayed for several minutes because her "birth keeper" would only call an ambulance if she consented.

items.title: Craft retailer Lincraft to close rest of its stores in Australia and NZ
items.description: Retailer Lincraft will close the remainder of its shopfronts after more than 80 years of providing fabric, materials and homewares to Aussie crafters.

items.title: Quick hits: Cabo Verde finds player on LinkedIn, meet Merlin the Duck
items.description: Cabo Verde's incredible result against Spain brings with it no shortage of amazing stories, while a duck in a jersey is stealing hearts in Mexico. Here are today's quick hits from the World Cup.

items.title: Ben Roberts-Smith's bail conditions varied to attend war memorial event
items.description: War veteran Ben Roberts-Smith's bail conditions have been varied so he can attend an opening at the Australian War Memorial in Canberra next week.

items.title: Teenager accused of planning terror attack targeted LNP over nuclear policy
items.description: A teenager accused of planning a terror attack in Brisbane allegedly wanted to target the Liberal National Party over their nuclear policy.

items.title: My parents were much older than those of my peers — it made life difficult
items.description: Having older parents has shaped my life in many ways, including taking on a carer role for Mum and Dad in my 20s.

items.title: 38yo man jailed for life over 'highly brutal murder' of 22yo wife in NT
items.description: Braden Jentian, 38, has been sentenced to life behind bars for the "protracted and highly brutal murder" of his 22-year-old female partner, whose body was found in a vacant block in Katherine in 2024.

items.title: Officer tells inquest he gave man one second to drop knife before fatal shot
items.description: A Special Emergency Response Team officer tells a coronial inquest it took one second or less to storm a bathroom and fire the shot that killed Far North Queensland man Aubrey Donahue during a hostage siege.

items.title: Ex-Hawke minister-turned Catholic priest farewelled in Hobart
items.description: Michael Tate — an academic, politician, diplomat and Catholic priest — has been remembered as a generous man whose life was one of "warmth and service to others".

items.title: Rabbits are everywhere in the wild, so why is rabbit meat so expensive?
items.description: Once a cheap meat for families doing it tough, the price and availability of rabbit means it has gone from family dinner to fine dining.

items.title: Five positive things having cash in the bank can do for you
items.description: Saving is not the only tool you need to achieve financial security these days, but it still has a role to play if you can manage it.

items.title: Eight crew believed dead in California B-52 bomber crash
items.description: A US Air Force B-52 bomber, designed to carry nuclear and conventional weapons, crashes shortly after taking off at an air base.

items.title: Taylor visits Alice Springs, renews call for Indigenous funding audit
items.description: Federal Opposition Leader Angus Taylor has visited Alice Springs, where he has met family of Kumanjayi Little Baby and renewed the Coalition's calls for deeper scrutiny of federal funding directed to the region.

items.title: Sydney shark attack victim loses arm ahead of 'long' recovery, family says
items.description: The family of Sydney mother Leah Stewart, who was mauled by a shark at Coogee Beach, says she has more surgeries scheduled for coming days.

items.title: Daley reveals Strange's new role as Blues aim to clinch Origin series win
items.description: After his starring role for the Blues in State of Origin I, Ethan Srange is given a new assignment against the Maroons at the MCG on Wednesday night.
